name: default
about: Production panel: one judge per model family, blind and independent; the median over judges is the panel score. No advocate or attacker seats: on 2026-11-22 they correlated 0.93-0.96 with the neutral judge of the same model (docs/lab/components/C15_multi_model_panel.md). Seats whose CLI, key or server is missing on this machine are skipped and reported: today Claude runs in the cloud, Codex on Tsahi's Mac; Gemini needs GEMINI_API_KEY, the open-weight seat a local Ollama server.

seats._note: kept only so the 2026-11-22 answers stay attributable; run it with --seats advocate if you want to retest stances
